column1: # Jabeja fork only: every live OpenMausBot that fork/deploy-beast.sh rolls out
# to, one per line (SSOT). Same image everywhere; each its own container,
# port, code and data. The port is the server's inside its container; paths
# are absolute when they start with /, else relative to $HOME on the host; the
# live folder holds DEPLOYED_COMMIT. Host "beast" means $BEAST_HOST
# (fork/beast.sh); another ssh alias is used as is; a jump chain
# hop>container>target>vm means ssh hop, docker exec -i container ssh target,
# incus exec vm (see host_cmd in fork/deploy-beast.sh). Builds always run on
# the beast; another host gets the built release copied over.
# ripal runs inside VM hermes-vm on node1 (159.69.74.253), port published on
# 100.86.49.68:8811 (tailnet only). node1 only lets in the beast's container
# omb, so it is reached through that; commands in the VM run as root.
# pe = Private Equity for Miguel (Ripal), own container next to omb-ripal,
# port published on 100.86.49.68:8812; isolated from omb-ripal's data.
